name: Hot Chocolate
description: A mug of cocoa that fills over one minute, the level following the seconds: swirling chocolate, floating sprinkles and stars, whipped cream on top, candy-pink sky above.

steps.script: const n = project.elements.length; for (const i of [n-3,n-2,n-1]) project.elements[i].name += ' Main'; return 1
